policies.text: A vendor is assigned a public transit service contract provided it maintains high-tier carrier standing and secures liability coverage of 3,000,000 USD or greater.
A rail freight carrier obtains heavy haul authorization provided its total locomotives count equals at least 40 units.
A shuttle provider gains terminal access rights if its operational minibuses count reaches 15 or more.
A commercial airline receives preferred gate allocation if its flight cancellation rate last month remains below 2 percent.

High-tier carrier standing is conferred when an operator maintains a vehicle safety score of 90 points or above, carries a Passenger Carrier License, and logs completed trips last quarter of 100 or higher.
A logistics company receives expedited terminal processing when its on-time dispatch rate last month is at least 90 percent.
A watercraft operator is licensed for shoreline passenger routes provided it holds a Maritime Safety Certificate.
